title: FunnelWatch
text:
We’re losing the most people at **visit → signup**.

- **Visit → signup:** 2,810 visits to 346 signups = **12.3% conversion**, so **~87.7% drop-off** (about **2,464** people don’t sign up).
- **Signup → activation:** 346 to 214 = **61.8% conversion**, so **~38.2% drop-off** (about **132** people).
- **Trial → paid:** 214 activations to 105 paid = **49.1% conversion**, so **~50.9% drop-off** (about **109** people).

By both rate and absolute volume, **visit → signup is the biggest leak** today.
